scripts.detekt:
bash -c 'color() { if [ $1 -eq 0 ]; then echo -e "\033[32m"; else echo -e "\033[31m"; fi }; detekt_output=$(mktemp); prettier_output=$(mktemp); ./gradlew detekt > "$detekt_output" 2>&1 & detekt_pid=$!; prettier --write . > "$prettier_output" 2>&1 & prettier_pid=$!; wait $detekt_pid; detekt_exit_code=$?; wait $prettier_pid; prettier_exit_code=$?; echo -e "\033[1;34mOutput from detekt:\033[0m"; while IFS= read -r line; do printf "\033[34m%s\033[0m
" "$line"; done < "$detekt_output"; printf "

"; echo -e "\033[1;32mOutput from prettier:\033[0m"; while IFS= read -r line; do printf "\033[32m%s\033[0m
" "$line"; done < "$prettier_output"; rm "$detekt_output" "$prettier_output"; detekt_status="Success"; prettier_status="Success"; if [ $detekt_exit_code -ne 0 ]; then detekt_status="Error (Code: $detekt_exit_code)"; fi; if [ $prettier_exit_code -ne 0 ]; then prettier_status="Error (Code: $prettier_exit_code)"; fi; printf "

Summary:
  Detekt: $(color $detekt_exit_code)%s\033[0m
  Prettier: $(color $prettier_exit_code)%s\033[0m
" "$detekt_status" "$prettier_status"'
